text:
Nina (Partnerships): 48h to marketplace launch - final checklist thread. Drop red flags now.
Cal (Product): Listing copy + SKUs done. Need hero asset and partner quote.
Tori (Marketing): Hero almost ready. Mobile crop missing. Can we ship with desktop hero and retrofit mobile?
Nina (Partnerships): Prefer consistent hero at launch. Tori, can design prioritize mobile crop in next 4 hours?
Tori (Marketing): Yes, will ping design lead.
Alex (Partner): From partner side: we approved logo use but request specific clearspace. Sending brand kit link.
LegalBot: Received brand kit. Approve usage subject to clearspace rule.
Ravi (Eng): SI onboarding tests passing. One small issue: tenant create returns 502 intermittently in eu-central-1 under load. Adding exponential retry in client lib.
Sven (Platform): Noted. I'll add a canary limiter for partner listings to cap concurrent onboarding sessions at 50 until warmup completes.
Cal (Product): Who owns partner landing copy? I'll take it if Ravi supplies the integration snippet.
Ravi (Eng): Snippet below. Keep short.
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/tenants \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"name":"partner-tenant","region":"eu-central-1"}'
```
Include note: "If you see transient 502, retry after 2s".
Tori (Marketing): Embargo set 11am CET Friday. Blog + press + partner email all synced.
Nina (Partnerships): Assets matrix: hero (Tori), logos (Alex + LegalBot), snippet (Ravi), screenshots (Cal), throttles/runbook (Sven). Any gaps?
Alex (Partner): We'll provide a short partner quote by EOD.
LegalBot: Privacy blurb suggested: "Usage data processed per Redwood and Partner terms." Partner acceptance needed.
Alex (Partner): We accept that phrasing.
Sven (Platform): Preflight scheduled 05:00 CET tomorrow. Will validate redirects, CDN purge, and concurrency caps.
Ravi (Eng): Retry PR merged to staging. CI green.
Tori (Marketing): Mobile hero crop uploaded to shared drive.
Sven (Platform): Preflight done: redirect chain clean, CDN purge complete, concurrency cap applied. Observed one provisioning 502 but client retry handled it. Marking as green-with-note.
Cal (Product): Screenshots captured and uploaded. Playbook drafted.
Nina (Partnerships): All clear pending partner quote. Final go/no-go call Monday 08:30 CET. Thanks team, keep this thread for blockers only. :rocket:
